Commentary.Commentary: All eyes will be on Dhawan now as the southpaw is out of form. With his place on line can he answer his critics?
India will have to negotiate an irritating 25-30 minutes before Lunch, just like New Zealand had to do yesterday. The Kiwi seamers will hope for a wicket or two before the break. Stay tuned.

India will have to negotiate an irritating 25-30 minutes before Lunch, just like New Zealand had to do yesterday. The Kiwi seamers will hope for a wicket or two before the break. Stay tuned. Shami did the cleanup job this morning, removing Watling and Wagner. He ended up with 3 wickets. Jadeja and Ashwin finished with a wicket apiece. They might have a different story to tell in the final innings.

You won't see this much often, so treasure this scorecard. On an Indian pitch, which is supposed to assist spin, seamers have taken 8 wickets. Bhuvneshwar Kumar swung the game last evening, with 3 wickets in the space of 18 balls, thereby taking a 5-fer.

A big lead for India but excellent fightback from the Kiwis. They were trailing by 188 last evening and considering that they had only 3 wickets in hand, to add 76 runs is a very good effort. Jeetan Patel and Bradley Watling frustrated the Indians this morning, adding 60 for the 8th wicket, helping New Zealand cross 200.

OUT! LBW! Shami takes the last wicket. It was landed on a good length, around leg, Wagner looked to defend but the ball skidded on and beat the bat to hit the pad. Shami appealed and the umpire raised his finger. Oh dear... replays show that the ball pitched outside leg. Tough luck. INDIA GET A LEAD OF 112!
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
SIX! Crash! A short ball around middle, Wagner cashes in and pulls it over mid-wicket! 200 up for the Kiwis!
On middle, Wagner works it through mid-wicket. Ravichandran Ashwin trundles after it and fumbles near the ropes. There is a chance for the third but Boult is not interested.
Outside off, a play and a miss.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.

MISSES THE STUMPS! Lovely comeback from Ashwin, Trent comes forward to defend but the ball spins in and hits the back pad. It goes over the stumps and Saha misses it as well. However, byes signalled instead of leg byes.
SIX! What a shot! Full and outside off, Boult gets down and swings it over long on!
Full and outside off, well defended.
Fuller in length this time, Wagner gets down and across and paddles it through fine leg for a single.
Around middle, defended from the crease.
On middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Oh dear... Boult gets across and looks to flick it down the leg side, exposing all his stumps. Shami targets the sticks but pitches the ball around middle and the ball goes down the leg side.

WHERE IS SHORT LEG? Not in play. A good short ball around middle, Boult stays back to defend but ends up pushing it tamely. The ball pops up in the air towards where short leg would have been but that area is vacant. Now Kohli asks Rohit Sharma to don the helmet and man that region.
Outside off, Boult has a play and a miss.
TRENT BOULT is the last man in. Can the tail wag for the Kiwis?

OUT! LBW! Watling's vigil is over. Full and straight, guess the ball swung a bit, Watling was late in getting his bat down, being defeated by the movement and was hit on the pads. Shami appealed and the umpire raised his finger. Watling hurries off the field. Perhaps he does not think the last wicket stand will last much.
Loose shot. Length ball outside off, Watling flays but misses.
Shorter in length around middle and leg, Wagner stays back to defend.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and straight, well kept out.
Beautifully flighted around middle, Neil watchfully plays it towards covers.
Outside off, pushed towards covers.
LBW appeal but turned down. Flighted around middle and leg, Wagner comes forward to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. Would have gone down the leg side.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
A length ball around middle, NW turns it towards backward square leg for a single to get off the mark. The deficit is now 129.
Full and outside off, tempting line, Neil thinks about the drive but takes his bat away from the line.
Similar ball, watchfully blocked out.
Around off, coming from around the wicket, Wagner defends.
Full and outside off, Watling pushes it to third man for a single. He wanted two but the fielder was very quick.
MOHAMMED SHAMI is back on to run through the tail.

Short and outside off, BJ punches it through the covers. Ravindra Jadeja chases it down but generously gives Watling enough time to take the second. Wagner accepts the invitation and goes for it but Watling loudly says no. It is the last ball of the over and he would not want more than a single.
Beautifully flighted outside off, Bradley initially aims to flick it away but then adjusts to push it to mid off.
Landed outside off, well blocked out.

ALMOST DRAGS IT ON! Heart-in-mouth moment for Watling. Full and outside off, Watling lunges to defend but the ball spins in sharply, takes the inside edge and just goes past the leg stump! Fine leg cuts it off and Watling wants the third but Wagner sends him back.
Full and outside off, played to the off side.
NEIL WAGNER walks in at number 10, replacing Patel.

Drinks break! A good hour for New Zealand. One of those rare periods where they managed to frustrate India. The hosts would have aimed to be batting by now, but Patel and Watling kept them at bay. India will now look to bowl out New Zealand under 200. How much can the Kiwis add?

OUT! Ashwin strikes first ball! What was that from Jeetan Patel though? It's a fullish delivery outside off, Patel tries to hit it down the ground but mistimes it completely. The ball goes high up in the air and Shami gets under it by running to his right from mid off. Smile on Kohli and Ashwin's faces. Jeetan Patel departs after a run-a-ball 47. Handy knock by him though. End of a solid partnership of 60 runs. New Zealand lose their eighth wicket, trail by 134 runs.
Virat Kohli is shining the ball and throws it to Ravichandran Ashwin.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is not happy with the shape of the ball and the umpires are changing it. Now Virat Kohli is not happy with the replacement ball.
Fullish outside off, BJ gets onto his front foot and defends.
Outside off, left alone.
Landed around off, Watling defends it into the ground.
Outside off, BJ blocks it off his back foot.
Good length ball outside off, Watling defends it with soft hands.
Around off, Patel defends it watchfully.

NO BALL! Jeetan Patel survives! Tossed up on middle and off, Patel goes onto his back foot and tries to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. Big appeal for a leg before and the umpire Kettleborough raises his finger. The umpire asks the batsman to wait though as he wants to have a look at the replays and the video evidence shows Jadeja's foot is not landing behind the line and it's a no ball. Heartbreak for Jadeja!
Patel is given out LBW but the umpire is checking Jadeja's front foot.
FOUR! Another boundary! Patel flicks it through the mid-wicket region and no fielders moved there. Another boundary for the comeback player.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On middle and off, Patel flicks it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Two in two! Very full on middle and leg, Patel drives it through wide mid on and gets another boundary.
50-run stand up between Jeetan Patel and BJ Watling! Solid partnership for the Kiwis here. India are still searching for their first breakthrough of the day.
FOUR! Jadeja drags it short outside off, Patel goes onto his back foot and punches it through the cover-point region and gets another boundary.
Fuller length ball on off, Watling drives it to mid on.
In the corridor outside off, BJ shoulders his arms.
Tad short outside off, Watling punches it away off his back foot.
Landed around off, Watling defends it from within his crease.
Good length ball around off, Watling defends it solidly.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Back of a length ball outside off, Watling punches it through the cover region for a boundary.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is back.
Landed around off, Jeetan pushes it towards point.
Down the leg side, Patel tries to paddle but misses. The keeper fails to collect the ball as well and the batsmen take two byes.
Landed around off, Patel defends it from within his crease.
Tossed up ball outside off, Jeetan shoulders his arms.

Well, that was quick. The covers are coming off and the umpires make it back to the field. Sun is out too. The players make their way to the middle. Virat Kohli is having some discussion with the umpires here, not sure what but he's not pleased with some decision. Okay so they showed the replays and the umpire was not happy when it started raining and he moved away but Jadeja continued to bowl. The umpires gave a warning there and Kohli was arguing about that. Anyway, the action resumes...

It has started to rain. The umpires decide to take the players off but Kohli doesn't look pleased with that decision. In fact as I type it has stopped raining already but the ground staff bring on more covers, probably as precautionary measures. It's gone really dark though. Stay tuned as we'll keep you posted with latest updates.
Fullish on middle and leg, Watling works it through mid-wicket for a single.

Good length ball outside off, Watling pushes it to point.
Landed around off, Watling blocks it solidly.
Change of ends for Shami.
FOUR! Another good shot! Tossed up on the pads, Patel paddles it to the long leg region. The ball wins the race and goes past the fence.
Full ball outside off, Patel gets onto his front foot and blocks.

Ravindra Jadeja into the attack.

EDGED! FOUR! Back of a length ball outside off, Patel tries to push but gets an outside edge. The ball goes past the second slip fielder and races away to the fence.

That's a brave leave! Good length ball outside off, swinging in, Watling lets it go through. The ball just misses the off stump.
Landed outside off, Patel plays it past point for a single.
FOUR! That's a lovely shot! Fuller length ball outside off, Patel drives it through the extra cover region for a glorious boundary.
Good length ball outside off, Watling taps it to the off side for a quick single.
Length ball on off, BJ flicks it to mid-wicket.
Landed around off, Watling defends it with soft hands.
On the pads, Patel works it to the fine leg region. Pujara, who was not on the field yesterday does well to stop the ball and saves a couple.

NOT OUT! Watling survives! Length ball outside off, Jeetan Patel drives it through the extra cover region. Jadeja runs towards the ball from mid off and throws it superbly at the non-striker's end. Dhawan collects it there and whips off the bails quickly as the batsmen go for a couple. Watling dives to make it in and replays show he just makes it.
There is a big appeal for a run out. Watling looks in trouble here.
Howzzat? Length all around off, angling in, Patel tries to push but misses. There is an appeal for a caught behind but the umpire says not out. Replays show the ball brushed the thigh pad.
Landed outside off, Patel pushes it to point.
On middle and off, angling in, Patel tries to work it across but misses. The ball goes to the leg side off the thigh pad. Rohit Sharma is fielding at short leg but he's a bit deep.

Mohammed Shami to bowl from the other end.

Right then! Virender Sehwag rings the Eden bell to get play underway. The players make their way to the middle, Virat Kohli leads his troops. Bhuvneshwar Kumar to bowl first up, he'll look to add more wickets to his tally. Jeetan Patel and BJ Watling stride out to battle it out for the visitors. Here we go!

Morning everyone! Welcome to the coverage of the day 3 of the second Test between India and New Zealand in Kolkata. The hosts are right on top after leaving the Kiwis on 128/7 yesterday with 188 runs behind. Due to rain yesterday, we have an early start today here. The good news is it's bright and sunny at the moment. Let's hope it stays like this and we get full play. Should be another exciting day of Test cricket.
...Day 3, Session 1...

There was a rain delay and that shifted momentum in India's favour even more as New Zealand lost quick wickets in that tricky session under floodlights. Bhuvneshwar Kumar made full use of that situation and grabbed his 4th 5-fer. BJ Watling is still out there and he has a tough task tomorrow. He has to bat with the tail and he'll look to add as much as possible. The Indian bowlers would be looking to take the remaining wickets quickly so join us tomorrow where we have an early start at 0915 IST to catch all the action. Goodbye! Cheers!

Earlier in the day, India managed to cross the 300-run mark and thanks to Saha's unbeaten fifty for that. In reply, New Zealand were off to a poor start yet again as they lost their openers in no time. Taylor and Ronchi shared a 62-run stand for the fourth wicket but it was cut short as well when Jadeja got the important breakthrough of Ronchi.

What a day for India! That evening session went in the hosts' favour completely. The Kiwis were left reeling as they lost wickets in a bunch. They lost three quick wickets, including the big scalp of captain Ross Taylor. Bhuvneshwar Kumar was sensational with the ball as he grabbed a 5-wicket haul. New Zealand are still 188 runs behind then and have just three wickets in hand.
The umpires take another reading and this time they feel it's not good enough. And with that, it is STUMPS ON DAY 2! The Indian players are shaking hands as they had a superb day on the field.

Full and just outside off, well defended.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single. 189 is the deficit now.
Full and outside off, defended in front of silly point.

The light has faded and the umpires have brought out the light meter again. Perhaps they have warned Kohli against using fast bowlers as RAVINDRA JADEJA has been brought upon. Let's see who is it from the other end.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A bouncer on middle, Jeetan ducks.
FOUR! Not a bad shot. Full and outside off, Patel drives this on the up through the covers and gets enough on it to make the ball meet the fence.
So close!!! Slightly short of a fuller length outside off, Patel plays a loose drive and is just about beaten.
JEETAN PATEL walks out at number 9, replacing Henry, to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! BOWLED! Bhuvi is on a hat-trick! What a ball. He is making the ball talk. On a length outside off, Henry too stays back in his crease like Santner to defend but the ball jags back in, stays low and hits the off stump. 4TH 5-FER for Bhuvi, his first at home in Tests.
MATT HENRY walks in at number 8, replacing Santner.

OUT! LBW! With the ball swinging, Bhuvi is no less than a king. Full and outside off, Santner stays back to defend but the ball swings back in, beats the bat and hits Santner flush on the pads. Up goes the umpire's finger without much time on the appeal.
The light meters are out again. The light is dipping consistently.
The batsman has driven it through mid on.
Full and outside off, pushed through cover point for a single.
Landed outside off, MS looks to punch but misses. The ball lands in front of the keeper who gets hit on the finger. Wrings his hand in pain.
Pitched outside leg, Mitchell misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads towards square leg.
Full and straight, watchfully defended.

FIVE WIDES! Shami goes for a bit too much, bangs it in the middle of the pitch, Santner ducks a bit but he doesn't have to. The ball flies over the top and beats a leaping Wriddhiman Saha to the fine leg fence.
Short and outside off, cut to deep point for a single. The deficit is now 199.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total. Watling moves to 10.
Umpire Rod Tucker has given the first official warning for Bhuvneshwar Kumar for running on the danger area. Another warning and that will be it for him in this innings with the ball.
Short and outside off, Bradley looks to cut but gets a bottom edge towards point.
FOUR! Crack! Fractionally short and outside off, Watling gets on top of the bounce and punches it through covers for a boundary! The stand moves to 10 from 15 balls.
Outside off, left alone.
Landed outside off, well defended.
Full and outside off, swinging away, left alone.
Full and outside off, pushed towards point for a run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Landed outside off, defended to the off side for a single.
Just before the Taylor dismissal, the two umpires had checked the light with the light meter. They were happy with it.
Landed outside off, short in length, Santner sways away from the line.
Outside off, left alone.
Full and straight, watchfully defended.
Plays another one straight to point.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
FOUR! Flashes and flashes hard! Short and outside off, hint of width, Watling goes hard at it and gets a thick outside edge which flies past gully to third man!
Outside off, left alone.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
BRADLEY WATLING walks in at number 7, replacing Taylor.

OUT! Edged and taken! The captain is gone! Taylor is walking back with a wry smile on his face. Perhaps he did not want to continue playing in this fading light. No one can blame him. The conditions are perfect for fast bowling with the ball not that visible to the batsmen. On top of that, the pitch is behaving indifferently. Also, Kohli went for the kill, as India have nothing to lose. He gambled with fast bowlers bowling which could force the umpires to take the players off but could also produce a wicket. And the gamble worked. Bhuvi landed this on a good length outside off. Nothing special on the delivery in terms of movement. Perhaps it straightened a touch. Taylor pushed at it. The ball bounced a shade extra, hit the top portion of the bat, took the outside edge and went straight to Murali Vijay at first slip with eyes wide open. NEW ZEALAND TRAIL BY 212.
BHUVNESHWAR KUMAR is back on.
Landed outside off, short in length, left alone.
Short and outside off, Taylor cuts hard and gets a thick outside edge which flies behind point to the man in the deep. A single taken.
Short outside off, Taylor slashes hard and misses. The ball lands in front of the keeper.
Smart bowling, fuller in length this time, checks Taylor's footwork who is probably expecting a short ball. Stays back, comes forward late and gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.

INSIDE EDGE! FOUR! Shami is really steaming in here. On a good length outside off, Taylor looks to defend but the ball nips back in sharply, bounces high as well, cuts Taylor into half and goes off the inside edge over the stumps to third man! 100 up for New Zealand.

FOUR BYES! That has taken off. Short and outside off, Taylor goes for the cut shot but the ball bounces sharply and surprises him. It flies over the top edge and even goes over the leaping Wriddhiman Saha to the third man fence! The deficit is now 217.
It has started to rain again. Just a slight drizzle though. We have a sightscreen issue here now, this is the last thing we could ask for...

Length ball outside off, Santner shoulders his arms.
Mohammed Shami comes on to bowl.

Right then! The players are back on the field. There is an Indian team huddle. Mitchell Santner joins Ross Taylor. Ravindra Jadeja to continue. Here we go...
Good news! Play will resume at 1600 IST!
Well, the players and the officials are still waiting as the covers are still on. In fact more covers are coming on. Oh dear...
GOOD NEWS! Match is set to resume at 1525 IST. The players are coming out for warm-ups.
The ground is still fully covered and the next inspection will be at 1455 IST...
Not entirely good news but still something to boot about. The drizzle seems to have stopped and the umpires have scheduled an inspection at 1425 IST (0755 GMT).
... DAY 2, SESSION 3 ...

With still 231 runs adrift and not much batting to come, the visitors have their work cut out. The scheduled resumption time is 1400 IST (0830 GMT) but don't think that is going to happen. Stay tuned for updates.

A good session for India then. They struck after Lunch and got the crucial wicket of the attacking Ronchi just before the rain came. Taylor and Ronchi had offered good resistance with a 62-run stand before Ronchi was dismissed by Jadeja. Earlier, Nicholls was cleaned up by Kumar.
Early TEA has been taken. The weather has started to clear a touch but it is still drizzling. The entire ground is covered.
The umpires take the players off the field. COVERS ARE ON! Wicket at the wrong time for New Zealand then. It looks just a drizzle though. Stay tuned as we'll keep you posted with latest updates...

There is a confident appeal for a leg before by Jadeja and co. and the umpire raises his finger this time. Jadeja celebrates and India get a vital breakthrough. Ronchi walks back and New Zealand slip further.

IN THE AIR... SAFE! On a length around middle, Ronchi looks to work it to the leg side but the ball stops a bit and he ends up checking his shot. It lobs wide of Shikhar Dhawan at mid on and Ronchi gets a single. The deficit is now 269.
FOUR! Beauty! What a shot. Full and outside off, Ronchi comes forward and drives it straight back down the ground for a boundary!
Landed outside off, well defended.
Full and outside off, well defended.

SIX! Clout! A short ball outside off, Ronchi pulls it over mid-wicket and gets a biggie! The deficit is now 276.
The ball seems to have gone out of shape. The umpires are checking the same.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
FOUR! That went off the top edge. Short and outside off, Taylor looked to pull but got a top edge which went over mid-wicket to the boundary.
Landed outside off, defended back to the bowler. Shami collects and has a shy at the striker's end and hits them, causing the crowd to rise and erupt.
Outside off, punched wide of cover for a single. Ravindra Jadeja has a shy at the bowler's end but Ronchi gets home with ease.

LUKE RONCHI walks in at number 5, replacing Nicholls, with his team in a mire.

OUT! Another indecision, another dismissal! It has been that sort of a day for the Kiwis. The batsmen have not quite been able to judge the bounce and hence that indecision to play or leave has been clouding their minds. On a good length around off, angling away, Nicholls looks to defend but the ball straightens a touch, takes the inside edge and hits the stumps.
Landed around off, short of full length, punched towards cover.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.

BHUVNESHWAR KUMAR to continue from the other end.

Welcome back for the post-lunch session. New Zealand on the back foot is an understatement. They have a mountain to climb and it will be interesting to see how they cope with the heat. The players are back out in the middle. Mohammed Shami will begin proceedings to Ross Taylor. Here we go...
... DAY 2, SESSION 2 ...

It is looking very, very difficult for New Zealand at the moment. The confidence is down and their fighting skipper Kane Williamson is not playing. Can the acting captain step up and give a fight? Join us back at 1210 IST (0640 GMT) for the second session.

An all-India session. That lunch will taste fantastic. First, their lower order frustrated New Zealand to rally the score past 300 and then the bowlers came out and dismissed both the opening batsmen to put the hosts in a very strong position.
Fuller length ball around off, Nicholls covers the line and defends. That's LUNCH ON DAY 2!
Shortish outside off, Taylor cuts it towards gully where Gambhir misfields and the ball goes towards backward point. Single taken.
Way outside off now, Taylor doesn't flirt with that one.
Length ball outside off, Taylor leaves it alone.
Around off, Taylor flicks it to mid-wicket.
Good length ball outside off, Taylor pushes it towards point.
Full around off, the Kiwi skipper flicks it through wide mid on for a single.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
On the pads, Nicholls flicks it away to the leg side for a single.
On middle and off, Nicholls blocks it off his back foot.
Good length ball around off, Nicholls defends it from within his crease.
In the corridor outside off, some extra bounce, Nicholls lets it go through.
Outside off, Taylor tries to push but gets a bottom edge to the keeper behind.
Play and a miss! Length ball outside off, shaping away, Taylor fails to put his bat on the ball.
Captain ROSS TAYLOR walks in next.

OUT! Guptill's poor run continues! Bhuvneshwar Kumar bowls a length delivery outside off, some extra bounce on this occasion, Guptill tries to shoulder his arms but the ball goes off the elbow and onto his stumps, thanks to that extra bounce. Beautiful bowling by Bhuvi and New Zealand have lost both their openers. Guptill looks in some pain too as he walks back. Not just the pain of getting hit on the elbow but the pain of getting out on a low score too.
BEATEN! Landed outside off, Guptill tries to push but misses. That was quite close.
FOUR! That's a lovely shot! Fuller length ball outside off, Guptill drives it through the cover region. The ball races away to the fence in no time.
Good length ball outside off, Guptill shoulders his arms.
FOUR LEG BYES! Angles it down the leg side, Nicholls tries to work it across but the ball goes off the thigh pad to fine leg. The umpire signals four leg byes.
HENRY NICHOLLS to bat next.

OUT! LBW! Shami draws first blood! Bowls a length ball around off, angling in towards the southpaw, Latham is forced to defend but misses it completely and gets hit on the pads. There is a big appeal for a leg before and the umpire raises his finger. Joy for India as they manage to get an early breakthrough.
Length delivery outside off, Martin taps it to point for a quick single.
Good length ball outside off, Guptill shoulders his arms. There is an appeal for a caught behind though as the ball probably brushes the elbow.
Short of a length ball angling down the leg side, Guptill leaves it alone.
Comes round the wicket and bowls it outside off, Latham plays it through point for a single.
MOHAMMED SHAMI to bowl from the other end.
That's a good comeback by Bhuvi! Length ball outside off, Guptill tries to defend but fails to put his bat on the ball.
FOUR! That's a poor ball! Length ball on the pads, Guptill flicks it through the mid-wicket region. No fielder there and MG gets back-to-back boundaries.

EDGED! FOUR! Not an ideal way to get off the mark but Guptill will take it. Good length ball outside off, Guptill pokes at it but gets an outside edge. The ball goes through the gap between second slip and gully and runs down to the third man fence.
In the corridor outside off, Guptill leaves it alone.
Fuller length ball around off, Guptill drives it towards mid off.
Starts off with a length delivery outside off, Guptill shoulders his arms.
